# d3dx8compat

Armies Of Tomorrow: a 64-bit replacement for the parts of D3DX8 the engine uses.

Microsoft never shipped D3DX8 for 64-bit, so a 64-bit build cannot link `d3dx8.lib`.
`cmake/dx8.cmake` builds this library only when `CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P` is 8. 32-bit
builds keep linking the original `d3dx8.lib` and are unchanged.

| Function | Implementation | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `D3DXMatrixInverse`, `Multiply`, `Transpose`, `Scaling`, `Translation`, `RotationX/Y/Z`, `fDeterminant` | Full, D3DX conventions (row-major, row vectors) | WWMath, W3DView, water, shadows, terrain |
| `D3DXVec3Transform`, `D3DXVec4Transform` | Full | Shadows, water |
| `D3DXGetFVFVertexSize` | Full | dx8fvf.cpp |
| `D3DXGetErrorStringA` | Prints the HRESULT in hex | dx8wrapper.cpp |
| `D3DXCreateTexture`, `CreateCubeTexture`, `CreateVolumeTexture` | Forward to the device, `D3DX_DEFAULT` handled | dx8wrapper.cpp |
| `D3DXLoadSurfaceFromSurface` | Copy, format conversion and box/point scaling for uncompressed formats; same-size copy for DXT | surfaceclass.cpp, dx8wrapper.cpp |
| `D3DXFilterTexture` | Box-filtered mip chain for 2D and cube textures | TerrainTex.cpp, W3DTreeBuffer.cpp |
| `D3DXAssembleShader` | Forwards to the 64-bit `d3dx9_43.dll` when present, otherwise fails | Water pixel shaders, profiler capture |
| `D3DXCreateTextureFromFileExA`, `D3DXLoadSurfaceFromFileA` | Fail, so the caller uses the missing texture | Fallback path only |

Known gaps:

- DXT mip chains are not regenerated by `D3DXFilterTexture`.
- Without `d3dx9_43.dll` the three water pixel shaders are not created and the water
  uses its fixed-function path.

## Test

`test/d3dx8compat_math_test.cpp` checks the math functions. From a Linux shell with
MinGW-w64 and Wine:

```
x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ -O2 -D_USE_MATH_DEFINES -I<min-dx8-sdk> \
  test/d3dx8compat_math_test.cpp <build>/d3dx8compat/libd3dx8compat.a -static -o t.exe
wine t.exe   # prints fails=0
```
